query: Do federal judges appointed by different Presidents (Trump vs. other Republican vs. Democratic) differ in their voting tendencies on immigration injunction cases? Do Trump-appointed judges tend to be more supportive of Trump administration immigration policies compared to judges appointed by other Republican or Democratic presidents?

schema.name: judge_name
schema.definition: The full name of the federal judge presiding over the case.
schema.rationale: Essential for identifying the specific judge and linking them to their appointing President.

schema.name: appointing_president
schema.definition: The name of the U.S. President who appointed the judge to the federal bench.
schema.rationale: Directly addresses the core query comparing Trump-appointed judges with those appointed by other Republican or Democratic presidents.

schema.name: appointing_president_party
schema.definition: The political party affiliation of the President who appointed the judge.
schema.rationale: Allows grouping and comparison of voting tendencies across broader partisan lines (Republican vs. Democratic).

schema.name: case_outcome_support_for_administration_policy
schema.definition: Indicates whether the judge's ruling supported or upheld the Trump administration's immigration policy or executive action.
schema.rationale: Directly answers whether judges are supportive of Trump administration immigration policies.

schema.name: injunction_ruling_type
schema.definition: The court's decision regarding the requested preliminary injunction or temporary restraining order.
schema.rationale: Identifies the specific voting tendency on immigration injunction cases.
allowed_values: granted in part and denied in part

schema.name: challenged_immigration_policy
schema.definition: The specific immigration policy, executive order, or program challenged in the case.
schema.rationale: Provides context on what policy was being evaluated (e.g., Alien Enemies Act, sponsor document requirements, National Qualified Representative Program).
allowed_values: Unaccompanied Children Program Foundational Rule / Sponsor Document Requirements
